heading: PROJECTS
description: Selected software systems, real-time architectures, AI developer tooling, and open-source contributions across Upblit and the Elixpo ecosystem.

projects.name: Upblit
projects.description: Core platform engineering, open-source architecture, and collaborative developer tools as a Core Member of the Upblit project.

projects.name: elixpo-ecosystem
projects.description: Active open-source contributions across the Elixpo ecosystem, including chat services, authentication platforms, and community developer tooling.

projects.name: Whisper
projects.description: A modern real-time chat application built with the MERN stack, featuring secure JWT authentication, instant WebSocket messaging, online status indicators, and responsive UI.

projects.name: Stack-Atlas
projects.description: AI-powered codebase intelligence tool that analyzes GitHub repositories and ZIP files to generate architectural system maps, structure insights, and tech stack breakdowns.

projects.name: DevMate
projects.description: Developer-focused Telegram bot built with Python and Docker providing cryptographic hashing (SHA-256), secure password generation, UUID generation, and developer automation.

projects.name: Fleet-Flow
projects.description: Production-grade Transport & Logistics Management System built with the MERN Stack featuring realtime vehicle tracking, shipment workflows, RBAC, analytics dashboards, and Socket.IO.
